overall: The Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law because its brief January 25 session was not a "meeting" (no deliberation), so no minutes were required.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee failed to timely approve minutes of its January 25 meeting, which were approved April 14, more than 30 days later.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the Committee was not obligated to create minutes for the January 25 meeting, and did not violate the Open Meeting Law.
